items.source: Returns the columns returned in this ReactiveResultSet.
items.translation: 返回此ReactiveResultSet中返回的列。

items.source: If the query that produced this ResultSet was a conditional update, return whether it was successfully applied.
items.translation: 如果产生此结果集的查询是条件更新，则返回其是否成功应用。

items.source: Return the execution information for all queries made to retrieve this ReactiveResultSet.
items.translation: 返回所有用于检索此ReactiveResultSet的查询的执行信息。

items.source: Returns information on the execution of the last query made for this ReactiveResultSet.
items.translation: 返回有关为此ReactiveResultSet执行的最后一个查询的信息。

items.source: Returns a Flux over the rows contained in this result set applying transparent paging.
items.translation: 返回一个 Flux，该 Flux 基于此结果集中的行数据，并应用透明分页。

items.source: Please note however that this ReactiveResultSet paging is not available with the version 1 of the native protocol (i.e. with Cassandra 1.2 or if version 1 has been explicitly requested). If the protocol version 1 is in use, a ReactiveResultSet is always fetched in it's entirely and it's up to the client to make sure that no query can yield ReactiveResultSet that won't hold in memory.
items.translation: 然而请注意，使用原生协议版本 1（即 Cassandra 1.2 或显式请求版本 1）时，不可用此ReactiveResultSet分页功能。如果使用的是协议版本 1，ReactiveResultSet将始终被完整获取，客户端需确保查询不会返回无法容纳在内存中的ReactiveResultSet。

items.source: The Flux will stream over all records that in this ReactiveResultSet according to the reactive demand and fetch next result chunks by issuing the underlying query with the current paging state applied.
items.translation: `Flux` 将根据反应式需求流式处理此 ReactiveResultSet 中的所有记录，并通过应用当前的 paging state 发出底层查询来获取下一批结果。

items.source: For consistency, this method always returns true for non-conditional queries (although there is no reason to call the method in that case). This is also the case for conditional DDL statements (CREATE KEYSPACE... IF NOT EXISTS, CREATE TABLE... IF NOT EXISTS), for which Cassandra doesn't return an [applied] column.
items.translation: 为保持一致性，此方法对于非条件查询始终返回 true（尽管在这种情况下无需调用该方法）。对于 Cassandra 不返回 [applied] 列的条件 DDL 语句（如 CREATE KEYSPACE... IF NOT EXISTS、CREATE TABLE... IF NOT EXISTS），情况也是如此。

items.source: The retrieval of the rows of a ReactiveResultSet is generally paged (a first page of result is fetched and the next one is only fetched once all the results of the first one has been consumed). The size of the pages can be configured either globally or per-statement with Statement.setPageSize(int).
items.translation: 对 ReactiveResultSet 的行进行检索通常是分页的（首先获取第一页结果，仅在第一页的所有结果被消费后才获取下一页）。页面大小可以通过 Statement.setPageSize(int) 在全局范围内或针对每个语句进行配置。

items.source: Note that in most cases, a result set is fetched with only one query, but large result sets can be paged and thus be retrieved by multiple queries. In that case this method return the ExecutionInfo for the last query performed. To retrieve the information for all queries, use getAllExecutionInfo().
items.translation: 请注意，在大多数情况下，结果集仅通过一次查询获取，但大型结果集可以分页，因此需要通过多次查询进行检索。在这种情况下，该方法将返回最后一次执行的查询的ExecutionInfo。若要获取所有查询的信息，请使用getAllExecutionInfo()。

items.source: Note that, for versions of Cassandra strictly lower than 2.0.9 and 2.1.0-rc2, a server-side bug (CASSANDRA-7337) causes this method to always return true for batches containing conditional queries.
items.translation: 请注意，对于严格低于 2.0.9 和 2.1.0-rc2 版本的 Cassandra，一个服务器端错误（CASSANDRA-7337）会导致此方法对于包含条件查询的批处理始终返回 true。

items.source: Unless the result set is large enough to get paged underneath, the returned list will be singleton. If paging has been used however, the returned list contains the ExecutionInfo objects for all the queries done to obtain this result set (at the time of the call) in the order those queries were made.
items.translation: 除非结果集足够大以至于需要分页，否则返回的列表将只包含单个元素。然而，如果使用了分页功能，则返回的列表将包含所有用于获取该结果集的查询（在调用时）所生成的 ExecutionInfo 对象，且这些对象按照查询执行的顺序排列。

items.source: Note that this class is not thread-safe.
items.translation: 请注意，该类不是线程安全的。

items.source:
The returned object includes basic information such as the queried hosts, but also the Cassandra query trace if
tracing was enabled for the query.
items.translation: 返回的对象包含查询主机等基本信息，如果已为查询启用跟踪功能，还会包含 Cassandra 查询跟踪信息。

items.source: Returns a Flux over the rows contained in this result set chunk. This method does not apply transparent paging. Use paging state from getExecutionInfo() to issue subsequent queries to obtain the next result chunk.
items.translation: 返回一个针对此结果集块中包含的行创建的Flux。此方法不应用透明分页。请使用来自getExecutionInfo()的paging state来发出后续查询，以获取下一个结果块。

items.source: Returns a Flux over the rows contained in this result set chunk.
items.translation: 返回一个 Flux，该 Flux 包含此结果集块中的行。

items.source: The reactive result of a query.
items.translation: 查询的反应结果。
